note: Protocol of the DX first-try test (features.md, 'DX first-try protocol'; bench/CHANGELOG.md entry 13). Models are pinned here (pre-authorized by the owner; protocol, models and token spend never wait for a go); a null id means not pinned and the runner refuses a real run until both are set. The gate is read on the primary model only; the stress model is reported next to it and adds no threshold.
